text: Greenpeace Onlus, ReCommon APS and 12 private citizens summoned Eni, the Italian Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) and Cassa Depositi e Prestiti (CDP) before the Civil Court of Rome on May 9, 2023, alleging climate-change responsibility and seeking a revision of Eni's decarbonisation strategy. Eni discloses the case in the commitments-and-contingencies section of its Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025; Eni, the MEF and CDP are all defendants. It is a pending suit, not a court finding.
